result.summary: Found 1 major issue: overlapping text under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card where the delivery time/fee line collides with the rating text.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, two text elements overlap: the delivery info line ('25–30 min delivery • Ramen') and the rating ('4.8 (500+)') are rendered on top of each other, making both hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout constraints so the rating and delivery info do not overlap — separate them onto distinct lines or allocate proper spacing/padding between the two text elements.
